conditions.evidence: Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare tumor of the adrenal cortex
conditions.label: Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC)

modalities.evidence: with available clinical, pathological data includes Ki-67 index

output.population: 53 confirmed ACC patients imaged between 2006 to 2018
output.summary: Retrospective contrast-enhanced CT studies of 53 confirmed adrenocortical carcinoma patients with clinical and pathological data including Ki-67 index, plus semi-automatic tumor segmentations refined by a radiologist for radiomic feature extraction.
